abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: Local PDB inspection found three protein-only structures with no HEADER/TITLE metadata and no non-water HETATM co-crystal ligands: target1 has one 151-residue chain J, target2 has one 257-residue chain A, and target3 has one 292-residue chain R. Sequence-only RCSB searches against extracted amino-acid sequences gave 100% identity public hits for all three targets: target1 maps to human Mcl-1, target2 to TYK2 JH2/pseudokinase-domain structures, and target3 to GPR119/glucose-dependent insulinotropic receptor GPCR fusion structures.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: Evidence files: experiments/target_analysis/local_structure_summary.json, rcsb_sequence_hits.json, rcsb_public_compact_summary.json, and rcsb_ligand_descriptors.json. No raw PDB content was copied. Key public ligand families: target1 Mcl-1 indole/benzothiophene/thiazepinoindole carboxylates or sulfonyl carboxamides; target2 TYK2 JH2 ATP-site/allosteric kinase-like aminopyridine, imidazopyridazine, pyridine carboxamide inhibitors; target3 GPR119 agonist/allosteric ligands including MBX-2982/GSK-1292263/firuglipel-like piperidine, oxadiazole, pyrimidine, tetrazole, sulfone motifs.

abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: Screened target-specific ligand anchors and conservative analog paths. For target1, Mcl-1 indole/benzothiophene/fused carboxylates and sulfonyl carboxamide 5X2 were compared; 5X2 had the best local descriptor/route proxy among screened Mcl-1 options and is an exact public co-crystal ligand. For target2, TYK2 JH2 ligands KZJ, L8Y, and 7GL were compared; KZJ was selected as the strongest structurally anchored inhibitor despite higher polarity because no analog route/descriptors justified losing exact co-crystal evidence. For target3, GPR119 ligands A1D8Y/GSK-1292263, 8VP/MBX-2982, and I7J/APD668 were compared; A1D8Y led local descriptor screening and is an exact GPR119 co-crystal ligand.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: Rejected weak changes: Mcl-1 19H and 4M6 were valid but had lower local proxy and less target-specific coverage than 5X2; TYK2 L8Y/7GL were valid but had lower tier-0 proxy and less compelling exact structure choice than KZJ; GPR119 8VP/I7J were valid but trailed A1D8Y. Sanitized targets lack co-crystal ligand boxes, so exact RCSB ligand identity, route validity, RDKit prep, and whole-box Vina sanity checks were weighted above speculative analog novelty. Evidence: experiments/candidate_screen/initial_descriptor_screen.json, experiments/target_analysis/pubchem_selected_ligands.json, RCSB 5FDO/6NSL/8ZRK, PubChem CIDs 90083030/118139924/24996872.

abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: Wrote exactly one final candidate archive to /work/targetmol/run/agent/candidate/result.zip. Zip member order is result1.csv, result2.csv, result3.csv, result.log; each CSV has header mol_smiles,route and exactly one row. /app/targetmol/validate_cli.py accepted the archive, reporting one row per target and sha256 141df62b31fda16062139dde4cd7236d12bff97ffbbb207c2f63a6d4b0f84bba. Independent Python zipfile/CSV/RDKit checks confirmed each route final product exactly equals mol_smiles and RDKit canonical products match.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: Offline evaluation evidence: tier 1 at experiments/final_eval_tier1 had 3 molecules, ok_count 3, failure_count 0, proxy mean/min 69.2233/64.4153 and official-weighted proxy mean/min 75.9190/75.6204. Tier 2 whole-box Vina at experiments/final_eval_tier2 had ok_count 3, failure_count 0, proxy mean/min 79.0241/74.3693, official-weighted proxy mean/min 85.7198/84.2165, and affinities target1 -9.349, target2 -8.295, target3 -6.858 kcal/mol. Tier 2 is advisory because sanitized inputs have no ligand HETATM-derived pocket box.
